test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following was replaced by the Green Revolution?

options.text: Use of seeds supplied by the government

solution:
The correct answer is the __**use of organic manures**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​The **Green Revolution** replaced **the use of organic manures **with chemical fertilizers and high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds to boost agricultural productivity.​
 
• **Green Revolution (1960s):**
 
 
• It was a** movement introduced to increase agricultural production,** primarily in India, using modern agricultural techniques,** including:**
 
 
• High-yielding variety (HYV) seeds.
 
• Chemical fertilizers.
 
• Pest
